get.description: Returns generic process health without dependency or deployment details.

Returns one purpose-minimized, current-scope approval inbox. Authorization and self-exclusion are applied before broad workflow-category, generic status, current-team, affected-date, sort, count, and pagination operations. Absence subtype, sickness classification, reasons, entitlement values, and source records are excluded.

post.description: Records an eligible non-self manager or HR decision for an absence cancellation. Approval appends any applicable entitlement restoration; it never edits the original deduction.

post.summary: Apply an approved correction to an unlocked daily record
Record a manager correction decision without applying it

post.description: Records a current eligible manager or HR acknowledgement of a sickness report. The acknowledgement adds no second absence, calculation, or entitlement effect.
Withdraws the employee’s pending cancellation request without changing absence coverage or balances.
Requests cancellation of all remaining effective coverage or an exact non-overlapping subset. The underlying absence and prior effects remain immutable while the request is pending.
Clocks in the authorized current employee using a required opaque Idempotency-Key header, optimistic attendance revision, trusted server occurrence minute, and atomic audit evidence.
Clocks out the authorized current employee, requiring explicit confirmation while on break and atomically closing that break before clock-out at one trusted server occurrence minute.

Resumes work by ending the authorized current employee break using a required opaque Idempotency-Key header, optimistic attendance revision, trusted server occurrence minute, and atomic audit evidence.
Starts a break for the authorized current employee using a required opaque Idempotency-Key header, optimistic attendance revision, trusted server occurrence minute, and atomic audit evidence.

get.description: Returns the authorized current employee attendance state, provisional calculation, warnings, and bounded event timeline for the organization-local current date.
get.summary: Get current employee attendance for today

get.description: Returns the current employee’s personal public holidays and active absence coverage for one organization-local month. It never returns team availability or another employee’s data.
Returns the minimum authenticated account and navigation context for the current actor.

post.description: Submits an employee-owned proposed work interval for review. Raw attendance events and daily calculations remain unchanged until a later authorized decision applies a correction.
post.summary: Submit a correction request for a daily record

get.description: Bootstraps the in-memory session-bound CSRF token used by WorkLedger unsafe requests.
Returns a read-only self profile and minimized active-session summaries for the current actor.

post.description: Revokes one active session owned by the current account after origin, CSRF, and freshness checks.

Reports full-day, schedule-half, or exact-minute sickness absence without accepting a note, diagnosis, attachment, or medical detail. Reporting creates the effective absence once; it awaits acknowledgement only.

get.description: Returns the authorized current employee week or month time-record summary with explainable flexible-time and leave-entitlement ledgers. Posted ledger facts and eligible unposted projections remain separate.
get.summary: Get current employee time records and balances

get.description: Returns one authorized current-employee daily record with an immutable event list and organization-local work/break intervals. It does not expose absence type, source IDs, or correction workflow data.
get.summary: Get current employee daily time record

post.description: Submits a full-day, schedule-half, or exact-minute employee vacation request. Every local date remains visible; public holidays and zero-hour dates consume zero entitlement. Pending approval reserves the calculated entitlement but does not change daily time calculations.
